entities.name: Ján Režňák
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ján Režňák was a Slovak war pilot. He was the top Slovak fighter ace in the Slovak Air Force during the Second World War. He accumulated 32 kills on the Eastern Front against the Soviet Union. He flew for the German Luftwaffe.
